Name: Ginger Island Gorilla Replacement
Author: medicsun
Description:
[size=4]Sorry for spoilers, it's late at night and I'm too lazy to make good warnings.

How to install: [/size]
Make sure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed (see requirements)
Extract the mod, which should be named "[CP] Gorilla Replacement" into your mods folder.
Should work fine!

The Gorilla shows up for like 6 seconds so this mod is practically useless but hey! Cool gorilla.

If you aren't a fan of how my gorilla looks, that's okay! I recommend checking out [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1965]Elle's Town Animals[/url], which includes replacements for Ginger Island.

This has the simplest coding I could think of so if it doesn't work, well... I don't know what to tell you.

Manifest.Name: Gorilla Replacement
Manifest.Description: Replaces the gorilla on Ginger Island
